subject: Inference node topology & ops handoff — scheduling review and follow-ups

Cc: Beth Carter <beth@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: architecture review for Dedicated GPU footprint (GridCloud POC)

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our infra team asked for a technical deep-dive focused on how Redwood would map our workload to dedicated GPU nodes: pool topology, isolation boundaries, autoscale behavior under burst, and KV cache considerations.

Would it be possible to schedule a 60–75 minute architecture review next week with your infra leads (we need someone who can answer kernel/quantization and autoscaling questions)? We’d like an ops-focused agenda so our SREs can validate the runbook and failover scenarios.

Rough availability from our side: Tue (6/29) 10–12 PT, Wed (6/30) 13–16 PT, or Thu (7/1) morning PT.

I can share our throughput profiles and a small dataset after we lock time.

Thanks —
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships, GridCloud
[Attachment: gridcloud_capacity_v2.xlsx (Excel, 480KB)]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: architecture review for Dedicated GPU footprint (GridCloud POC)

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask. Marissa (capacity & product) and Karthik (serving runtime) are cc’d — they’ll drive the technical content. Neha from Solutions can join for the rollouts/ops checklist if we need to talk SLAs and runbooks.

We can take Wed 6/30 at 14:00 PT for ~75 minutes if that works — I put a tentative placeholder on your calendar (see related_links). Proposed agenda below; please flag additions:

- 14:00 – 14:10: Introductions & POC objectives (Alex/Beth)
- 14:10 – 14:35: Workload profile & desired SLOs (GridCloud)
- 14:35 – 15:15: Redwood topology mapping: reserved pools, isolation lanes, and failover
- 15:15 – 15:40: Autoscaling behavior & cost/leverage tradeoffs (continuous batching + quantized models)
- 15:40 – 15:55: Runbook: burst scenarios, KV cache warm-up, and fallback policies
- 15:55 – 16:00: Action items & next steps

Attachments: I’m attaching our current inference topology doc for context. Can you confirm the dataset/throughput you’ll share and whether you expect air-gapped or VPC-only access during POC?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Alex —

Thanks — a couple quick asks so we can optimize the session:

1) Can you paste a small sample of the token distribution and 95th/99th percentile sequence lengths? That drives our kernel selection recommendations.
2) Will you be testing with multiple model variants or a pinned version during the POC?
3) Any compliance constraints (e.g., no public internet for KV caching)?

If you can send those by EOD Tuesday we’ll prepare a short ops-runbook slide (failover steps + a simple bash healthcheck we use).

--Marissa
Director, Product — Dedicated & Private
